spans.s:
n. (-कं)
1 Angry speech.
2 A minor drama, such as the Vikramorvaśī.
E.
त्रुट to cut, ण्वुल् aff.

f. (-की)
A Rāgiṇī or one of the female personifications of music.

f. (-टिः or टी)
1 The beak or bill of a bird.
2 A bird in general.
3 A kind of pike, (Esox kankila.)
4 A medicinal plant: see कट्फल.
E.
त्रुट to cut, affix अच्, and fem. affix इन् or ङीप्.

m. (-स्तः)
A bird in general.
E.
त्रोठि a beak, and हस्त a hand.

n. (-त्रं)
1 A goad.
2 A weapon.
E.
त्रै to preserve, उत्र Uṇādi aff.
